<?php

/* Shared functions for credit control: status, audit log, overdue calculation and the
 * debtors ledger postings for interest/fees, waivers and write-offs.
 *
 * Stop and watch are the existing credit status (holdreasons) records: a stop is a hold reason
 * with dissallowinvoices=1 and a watch one with dissallowinvoices=2, so every page that already
 * honours debtorsmaster.holdreason keeps working.
 */

define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 17); // credit controller, deputy and finance director
define('CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN', 21); // finance director: write-off approval and setup

function CanDoCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CanApproveCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* A sales rep (SalesmanLogin set) may only see his own customers. Customer log ons are
 * restricted to their own account. Returns false if the user may not see $DebtorNo */
function CreditControlCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (!empty($_SESSION['CustomerLogin']) and $_SESSION['CustomerLogin'] == 1) {
		return ($_SESSION['CustomerID'] == $DebtorNo);
	}
	if ($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesman='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		return (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* The hold reason code used for a credit control stop or watch, creating the record if the
 * database does not have it yet (for example a demo install). $Which is 'Stop' or 'Watch' */
function CreditControlReasonCode($Which) {
	$Name = 'CreditControl' . $Which . 'Reason';
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Name]) and $_SESSION[$Name] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$_SESSION[$Name] . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
			return (int)$_SESSION[$Name];
		}
	}
	$Description = ($Which == 'Stop') ? 'Credit control - on stop' : 'Credit control - on watch';
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasondescription='" . $Description . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(reasoncode) FROM holdreasons");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = max(89, (int)$MyRow[0]) + 1;
		DB_query("INSERT INTO holdreasons (reasoncode, reasondescription, dissallowinvoices)
					VALUES ('" . $Code . "', '" . $Description . "', '" . (($Which == 'Stop') ? 1 : 2) . "')");
	} else {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = $MyRow[0];
	}
	DB_query("DELETE FROM config WHERE confname='" . $Name . "'");
	DB_query("INSERT INTO config (confname, confvalue) VALUES ('" . $Name . "', '" . $Code . "')");
	$_SESSION[$Name] = $Code;
	return (int)$Code;
}

/* Current credit status of a customer: array('code', 'disallow' 0|1|2, 'description', 'name') */
function CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
							holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
							holdreasons.reasondescription
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Status = array('code' => 0, 'disallow' => 0, 'description' => '', 'name' => __('Normal'));
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['disallow'] = (int)$MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['name'] = CreditControlStatusName($Status['disallow']);
	}
	return $Status;
}

function CreditControlStatusName($Disallow) {
	if ($Disallow == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Disallow == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* True if no order may be accepted or released for the customer (credit status disallows invoicing) */
function CreditControlOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status['disallow'] == 1);
}

/* Write one line of the per customer credit control history (reviews, status and limit changes,
 * reminders, charges, waivers, write-offs). Never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $OldValue, $NewValue, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Reason) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno, eventdate, userid, eventtype, oldvalue, newvalue, amount, currcode, reason)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')",
			__('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* Put a customer on 'stop', 'watch' or back to 'normal' and log it. $NewStatus: 'stop', 'watch', 'normal'.
 * Returns true if the status changed. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $Reason) {
	$Old = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($NewStatus == 'stop') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Stop');
	} elseif ($NewStatus == 'watch') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Watch');
	} else {
		$Code = 0;
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode=0");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			return false; // no 'normal' credit status record, cannot clear
		}
	}
	if ($Code == $Old['code']) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $Code . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'status', $Old['name'], $New['name'], 0, '', $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Credit limit of a customer changed by credit control. */
function CreditControlSetLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditlimit'] != $NewLimit) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float)$NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
				__('The credit limit could not be updated because'));
		CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'limit', $MyRow['creditlimit'], $NewLimit, $NewLimit, $MyRow['currcode'], $Reason);
	}
}

/* Next review date for a customer account opened today */
function CreditControlDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths'] : 12;
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row (needs paymentterms joined as paymentterms) */
function CreditControlDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Open items of a customer that are past due, oldest first. Disputed items are left out.
 * $Types is a list of debtortrans types to include. Returns an array of rows with
 * id, type, transno, trandate, duedate, balance, daysoverdue. */
function CreditControlOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $Types = array(10, 70), $MinDaysOverdue = 1) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					" . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . implode(',', array_map('intval', $Types)) . ")
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.disputed=0
				AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Total account balance of a customer in its own currency (all open items, unallocated credits net) */
function CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float)$MyRow[0];
}

/* Amount of the overdue items that is really still owed: unallocated receipts and credit notes
 * on the account reduce what we chase or charge interest on. */
function CreditControlNetOverdue($Items, $DebtorNo) {
	$Total = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Total += $Item['balance'];
	}
	return max(0, min($Total, CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo)));
}

/* Last reminder stage sent in the current overdue episode (letters sent since the oldest
 * overdue item fell due), 0 if none. $OldestDueDate is Y-m-d */
function CreditControlLastStage($DebtorNo, $OldestDueDate = '1000-01-01') {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(stage) AS stage, MAX(sentdate) AS sentdate
						FROM dunninglog
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND sentdate >= '" . $OldestDueDate . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array((int)$MyRow['stage'], $MyRow['sentdate']);
}

/* Rate (customer currency per home currency unit) and decimal places for a currency */
function CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$MyRow or $MyRow['rate'] <= 0) {
		return array(1, 2);
	}
	return array($MyRow['rate'], $MyRow['decimalplaces']);
}

/* Insert a debtortrans row for a credit control posting. $Amount is signed, in customer currency.
 * Must be called inside the caller's transaction. Returns array(transid, transno). */
function CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $Reference, $Text, $PeriodNo) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
							(SELECT custbranch.branchcode FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS branchcode,
							(SELECT custbranch.salesman FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS salesman
						FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno, type, debtorno, branchcode, trandate, inputdate, prd, reference, tpe, order_, rate, ovamount, invtext, salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['branchcode']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						NOW(),
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salestype']) . "',
						0,
						'" . (float)$Rate . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salesman']) . "')",
			__('The debtors ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
	return array(DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id'), $TransNo);
}

function CreditControlInsertGL($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Account) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "')",
			__('The general ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
}

/* Allocate (part of) a credit item to an open debit item and settle them if they reach zero */
function CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $DebitID, $Amount) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . (float)$Amount . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$CreditID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$DebitID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')");
}

/* Post interest or a late fee (one charge row per customer, month and type) in the customer's
 * currency. Call inside a transaction. Returns false when the charge was already posted. */
function CreditControlPostCharge($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Month, $ChargeType, $Amount, $Basis) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id FROM creditcharges
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND chargemonth='" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "'
							AND chargetype='" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		return false;
	}
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	if ($Amount <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Description = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? __('Interest on overdue balance') : __('Late payment fee');
	list($TransID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 70, $Amount, $Rate, $Description . ' ' . $Month, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' - ' . $Basis, $PeriodNo);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype, amount, currcode, rate, transid, transno, basis, postedby, posteddate)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "',
						'" . $Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . $Rate . "',
						'" . $TransID . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Basis, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE)",
			__('The charge record could not be inserted because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'charge', '', $ChargeType . ' ' . $Month, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' (' . $Basis . ')');
	return true;
}

/* Waive (reverse) a posted charge: a credit at the charge's own rate allocated to the charge, with the
 * GL reversed. Call inside a transaction. */
function CreditControlWaiveCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM creditcharges WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "' AND waived=0");
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Charge) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'] . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($WaiverID, $WaiverNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($Charge['debtorno'], 71, -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, $Text, $PeriodNo);
	CreditControlAllocate($WaiverID, $Charge['transid'], $Charge['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate'], 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges SET waived=1, waivetransno='" . $WaiverNo . "', waivereason='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reason, 0, 200)) . "' WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'");
	CreditControlLog($Charge['debtorno'], 'waiver', $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'], '', $Charge['amount'], $Charge['currcode'], $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved write-off: a credit (type 72) allocated oldest first to the customer's open
 * debit items; GL credit to debtors at the items' original rates, debit to bad debts at today's rate,
 * the difference to the exchange difference account. Call inside a transaction.
 * Returns the write-off transaction number or 0 if the balance no longer covers the amount. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Amount, $Reason) {
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND balance > 0.005
						ORDER BY trandate, id FOR UPDATE");
	$Items = array();
	$Open = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Open += $MyRow['balance'];
	}
	if ($Amount <= 0 or $Amount > round($Open, $DecimalPlaces) + 0.005) {
		return 0;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($CreditID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 72, -$Amount, $Rate, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Text, $PeriodNo);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$HomeAtOriginalRates = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		if ($Remaining <= 0.005) {
			break;
		}
		$Part = round(min($Remaining, $Item['balance']), $DecimalPlaces);
		CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $Item['id'], $Part);
		$ItemRate = ($Item['rate'] > 0) ? $Item['rate'] : $Rate;
		$HomeAtOriginalRates += round($Part / $ItemRate, 2);
		$Remaining -= $Part;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeNow = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text;
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$HomeAtOriginalRates);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CreditControlBadDebtAct'], $Narrative, $HomeNow);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' (' . __('exchange difference') . ')', $HomeAtOriginalRates - $HomeNow);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Substitute the placeholders of a reminder letter */
function CreditControlLetterText($Template, $Name, $CurrCode, $Total, $InvoiceLines) {
	return str_replace(array('{name}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}', '{date}'),
		array($Name, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'], $CurrCode, locale_number_format($Total, 2), $InvoiceLines, date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'])),
		$Template);
}

	DB_query("DELETE FROM config WHERE confname='" . $Name . "'");
	DB_query("INSERT INTO config (confname, confvalue) VALUES ('" . $Name . "', '" . $Code . "')");
	$_SESSION[$Name] = $Code;
	return (int)$Code;
}

/* Current credit status of a customer: array('code', 'disallow' 0|1|2, 'description', 'name') */
function CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
							holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
							holdreasons.reasondescription
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Status = array('code' => 0, 'disallow' => 0, 'description' => '', 'name' => __('Normal'));
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['disallow'] = (int)$MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['name'] = CreditControlStatusName($Status['disallow']);
	}
	return $Status;
}

function CreditControlStatusName($Disallow) {
	if ($Disallow == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Disallow == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* True if no order may be accepted or released for the customer (credit status disallows invoicing) */
function CreditControlOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status['disallow'] == 1);
}

/* Write one line of the per customer credit control history (reviews, status and limit changes,
 * reminders, charges, waivers, write-offs). Never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $OldValue, $NewValue, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Reason) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno, eventdate, userid, eventtype, oldvalue, newvalue, amount, currcode, reason)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')",
			__('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* Put a customer on 'stop', 'watch' or back to 'normal' and log it. $NewStatus: 'stop', 'watch', 'normal'.
 * Returns true if the status changed. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $Reason) {
	$Old = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($NewStatus == 'stop') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Stop');
	} elseif ($NewStatus == 'watch') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Watch');
	} else {
		$Code = 0;
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode=0");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			return false; // no 'normal' credit status record, cannot clear
		}
	}
	if ($Code == $Old['code']) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $Code . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'status', $Old['name'], $New['name'], 0, '', $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Credit limit of a customer changed by credit control. */
function CreditControlSetLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditlimit'] != $NewLimit) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float)$NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
				__('The credit limit could not be updated because'));
		CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'limit', $MyRow['creditlimit'], $NewLimit, $NewLimit, $MyRow['currcode'], $Reason);
	}
}

/* Next review date for a customer account opened today */
function CreditControlDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths'] : 12;
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row (needs paymentterms joined as paymentterms) */
function CreditControlDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Open items of a customer that are past due, oldest first. Disputed items are left out.
 * $Types is a list of debtortrans types to include. Returns an array of rows with
 * id, type, transno, trandate, duedate, balance, daysoverdue. */
function CreditControlOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $Types = array(10, 70), $MinDaysOverdue = 1) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					" . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . implode(',', array_map('intval', $Types)) . ")
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.disputed=0
				AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Total account balance of a customer in its own currency (all open items, unallocated credits net) */
function CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float)$MyRow[0];
}

/* Amount of the overdue items that is really still owed: unallocated receipts and credit notes
 * on the account reduce what we chase or charge interest on. */
function CreditControlNetOverdue($Items, $DebtorNo) {
	$Total = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Total += $Item['balance'];
	}
	return max(0, min($Total, CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo)));
}

/* Last reminder stage sent in the current overdue episode (letters sent since the oldest
 * overdue item fell due), 0 if none. $OldestDueDate is Y-m-d */
function CreditControlLastStage($DebtorNo, $OldestDueDate = '1000-01-01') {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(stage) AS stage, MAX(sentdate) AS sentdate
						FROM dunninglog
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND sentdate >= '" . $OldestDueDate . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array((int)$MyRow['stage'], $MyRow['sentdate']);
}

/* Rate (customer currency per home currency unit) and decimal places for a currency */
function CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$MyRow or $MyRow['rate'] <= 0) {
		return array(1, 2);
	}
	return array($MyRow['rate'], $MyRow['decimalplaces']);
}

/* Insert a debtortrans row for a credit control posting. $Amount is signed, in customer currency.
 * Must be called inside the caller's transaction. Returns array(transid, transno). */
function CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $Reference, $Text, $PeriodNo) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
							(SELECT custbranch.branchcode FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS branchcode,
							(SELECT custbranch.salesman FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS salesman
						FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno, type, debtorno, branchcode, trandate, inputdate, prd, reference, tpe, order_, rate, ovamount, invtext, salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['branchcode']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						NOW(),
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salestype']) . "',
						0,
						'" . (float)$Rate . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salesman']) . "')",
			__('The debtors ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
	return array(DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id'), $TransNo);
}

function CreditControlInsertGL($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Account) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "')",
			__('The general ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
}

/* Allocate (part of) a credit item to an open debit item and settle them if they reach zero */
function CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $DebitID, $Amount) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . (float)$Amount . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$CreditID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$DebitID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')");
}

/* Post interest or a late fee (one charge row per customer, month and type) in the customer's
 * currency. Call inside a transaction. Returns false when the charge was already posted. */
function CreditControlPostCharge($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Month, $ChargeType, $Amount, $Basis) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id FROM creditcharges
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND chargemonth='" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "'
							AND chargetype='" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		return false;
	}
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	if ($Amount <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Description = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? __('Interest on overdue balance') : __('Late payment fee');
	list($TransID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 70, $Amount, $Rate, $Description . ' ' . $Month, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' - ' . $Basis, $PeriodNo);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype, amount, currcode, rate, transid, transno, basis, postedby, posteddate)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "',
						'" . $Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . $Rate . "',
						'" . $TransID . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Basis, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE)",
			__('The charge record could not be inserted because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'charge', '', $ChargeType . ' ' . $Month, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' (' . $Basis . ')');
	return true;
}

/* Waive (reverse) a posted charge: a credit at the charge's own rate allocated to the charge, with the
 * GL reversed. Call inside a transaction. */
function CreditControlWaiveCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM creditcharges WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "' AND waived=0");
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Charge) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'] . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($WaiverID, $WaiverNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($Charge['debtorno'], 71, -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, $Text, $PeriodNo);
	CreditControlAllocate($WaiverID, $Charge['transid'], $Charge['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate'], 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges SET waived=1, waivetransno='" . $WaiverNo . "', waivereason='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reason, 0, 200)) . "' WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'");
	CreditControlLog($Charge['debtorno'], 'waiver', $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'], '', $Charge['amount'], $Charge['currcode'], $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved write-off: a credit (type 72) allocated oldest first to the customer's open
 * debit items; GL credit to debtors at the items' original rates, debit to bad debts at today's rate,
 * the difference to the exchange difference account. Call inside a transaction.
 * Returns the write-off transaction number or 0 if the balance no longer covers the amount. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Amount, $Reason) {
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND balance > 0.005
						ORDER BY trandate, id FOR UPDATE");
	$Items = array();
	$Open = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Open += $MyRow['balance'];
	}
	if ($Amount <= 0 or $Amount > round($Open, $DecimalPlaces) + 0.005) {
		return 0;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($CreditID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 72, -$Amount, $Rate, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Text, $PeriodNo);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$HomeAtOriginalRates = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		if ($Remaining <= 0.005) {
			break;
		}
		$Part = round(min($Remaining, $Item['balance']), $DecimalPlaces);
		CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $Item['id'], $Part);
		$ItemRate = ($Item['rate'] > 0) ? $Item['rate'] : $Rate;
		$HomeAtOriginalRates += round($Part / $ItemRate, 2);
		$Remaining -= $Part;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeNow = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text;
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$HomeAtOriginalRates);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CreditControlBadDebtAct'], $Narrative, $HomeNow);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' (' . __('exchange difference') . ')', $HomeAtOriginalRates - $HomeNow);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Substitute the placeholders of a reminder letter */
function CreditControlLetterText($Template, $Name, $CurrCode, $Total, $InvoiceLines) {
	return str_replace(array('{name}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}', '{date}'),
		array($Name, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'], $CurrCode, locale_number_format($Total, 2), $InvoiceLines, date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'])),
		$Template);
}

/* Shared functions for credit control: status, audit log, overdue calculation and the
 * debtors ledger postings for interest/fees, waivers and write-offs.
 *
 * Stop and watch are the existing credit status (holdreasons) records: a stop is a hold reason
 * with dissallowinvoices=1 and a watch one with dissallowinvoices=2, so every page that already
 * honours debtorsmaster.holdreason keeps working.
 */

define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 17); // credit controller, deputy and finance director
define('CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN', 21); // finance director: write-off approval and setup

function CanDoCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CanApproveCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* A sales rep (SalesmanLogin set) may only see his own customers. Customer log ons are
 * restricted to their own account. Returns false if the user may not see $DebtorNo */
function CreditControlCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (!empty($_SESSION['CustomerLogin']) and $_SESSION['CustomerLogin'] == 1) {
		return ($_SESSION['CustomerID'] == $DebtorNo);
	}
	if ($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesman='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		return (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* The hold reason code used for a credit control stop or watch, creating the record if the
 * database does not have it yet (for example a demo install). $Which is 'Stop' or 'Watch' */
function CreditControlReasonCode($Which) {
	$Name = 'CreditControl' . $Which . 'Reason';
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Name]) and $_SESSION[$Name] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$_SESSION[$Name] . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
			return (int)$_SESSION[$Name];
		}
	}
	$Description = ($Which == 'Stop') ? 'Credit control - on stop' : 'Credit control - on watch';
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasondescription='" . $Description . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(reasoncode) FROM holdreasons");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = max(89, (int)$MyRow[0]) + 1;
		DB_query("INSERT INTO holdreasons (reasoncode, reasondescription, dissallowinvoices)
					VALUES ('" . $Code . "', '" . $Description . "', '" . (($Which == 'Stop') ? 1 : 2) . "')");
	} else {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = $MyRow[0];
	}
	DB_query("DELETE FROM config WHERE confname='" . $Name . "'");
	DB_query("INSERT INTO config (confname, confvalue) VALUES ('" . $Name . "', '" . $Code . "')");
	$_SESSION[$Name] = $Code;
	return (int)$Code;
}

/* Current credit status of a customer: array('code', 'disallow' 0|1|2, 'description', 'name') */
function CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
							holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
							holdreasons.reasondescription
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Status = array('code' => 0, 'disallow' => 0, 'description' => '', 'name' => __('Normal'));
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['disallow'] = (int)$MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['name'] = CreditControlStatusName($Status['disallow']);
	}
	return $Status;
}

function CreditControlStatusName($Disallow) {
	if ($Disallow == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Disallow == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* True if no order may be accepted or released for the customer (credit status disallows invoicing) */
function CreditControlOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status['disallow'] == 1);
}

/* Write one line of the per customer credit control history (reviews, status and limit changes,
 * reminders, charges, waivers, write-offs). Never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $OldValue, $NewValue, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Reason) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno, eventdate, userid, eventtype, oldvalue, newvalue, amount, currcode, reason)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')",
			__('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* Put a customer on 'stop', 'watch' or back to 'normal' and log it. $NewStatus: 'stop', 'watch', 'normal'.
 * Returns true if the status changed. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $Reason) {
	$Old = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($NewStatus == 'stop') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Stop');
	} elseif ($NewStatus == 'watch') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Watch');
	} else {
		$Code = 0;
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode=0");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			return false; // no 'normal' credit status record, cannot clear
		}
	}
	if ($Code == $Old['code']) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $Code . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'status', $Old['name'], $New['name'], 0, '', $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Credit limit of a customer changed by credit control. */
function CreditControlSetLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditlimit'] != $NewLimit) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float)$NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
				__('The credit limit could not be updated because'));
		CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'limit', $MyRow['creditlimit'], $NewLimit, $NewLimit, $MyRow['currcode'], $Reason);
	}
}

/* Next review date for a customer account opened today */
function CreditControlDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths'] : 12;
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row (needs paymentterms joined as paymentterms) */
function CreditControlDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Open items of a customer that are past due, oldest first. Disputed items are left out.
 * $Types is a list of debtortrans types to include. Returns an array of rows with
 * id, type, transno, trandate, duedate, balance, daysoverdue. */
function CreditControlOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $Types = array(10, 70), $MinDaysOverdue = 1) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					" . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . implode(',', array_map('intval', $Types)) . ")
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.disputed=0
				AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Total account balance of a customer in its own currency (all open items, unallocated credits net) */
function CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float)$MyRow[0];
}

/* Amount of the overdue items that is really still owed: unallocated receipts and credit notes
 * on the account reduce what we chase or charge interest on. */
function CreditControlNetOverdue($Items, $DebtorNo) {
	$Total = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Total += $Item['balance'];
	}
	return max(0, min($Total, CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo)));
}

/* Last reminder stage sent in the current overdue episode (letters sent since the oldest
 * overdue item fell due), 0 if none. $OldestDueDate is Y-m-d */
function CreditControlLastStage($DebtorNo, $OldestDueDate = '1000-01-01') {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(stage) AS stage, MAX(sentdate) AS sentdate
						FROM dunninglog
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND sentdate >= '" . $OldestDueDate . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array((int)$MyRow['stage'], $MyRow['sentdate']);
}

/* Rate (customer currency per home currency unit) and decimal places for a currency */
function CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$MyRow or $MyRow['rate'] <= 0) {
		return array(1, 2);
	}
	return array($MyRow['rate'], $MyRow['decimalplaces']);
}

/* Insert a debtortrans row for a credit control posting. $Amount is signed, in customer currency.
 * Must be called inside the caller's transaction. Returns array(transid, transno). */
function CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $Reference, $Text, $PeriodNo) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
							(SELECT custbranch.branchcode FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS branchcode,
							(SELECT custbranch.salesman FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS salesman
						FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno, type, debtorno, branchcode, trandate, inputdate, prd, reference, tpe, order_, rate, ovamount, invtext, salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['branchcode']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						NOW(),
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salestype']) . "',
						0,
						'" . (float)$Rate . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salesman']) . "')",
			__('The debtors ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
	return array(DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id'), $TransNo);
}

function CreditControlInsertGL($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Account) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "')",
			__('The general ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
}

/* Allocate (part of) a credit item to an open debit item and settle them if they reach zero */
function CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $DebitID, $Amount) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . (float)$Amount . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$CreditID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$DebitID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')");
}

/* Post interest or a late fee (one charge row per customer, month and type) in the customer's
 * currency. Call inside a transaction. Returns false when the charge was already posted. */
function CreditControlPostCharge($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Month, $ChargeType, $Amount, $Basis) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id FROM creditcharges
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND chargemonth='" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "'
							AND chargetype='" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		return false;
	}
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	if ($Amount <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Description = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? __('Interest on overdue balance') : __('Late payment fee');
	list($TransID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 70, $Amount, $Rate, $Description . ' ' . $Month, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' - ' . $Basis, $PeriodNo);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype, amount, currcode, rate, transid, transno, basis, postedby, posteddate)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "',
						'" . $Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . $Rate . "',
						'" . $TransID . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Basis, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE)",
			__('The charge record could not be inserted because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'charge', '', $ChargeType . ' ' . $Month, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' (' . $Basis . ')');
	return true;
}

/* Waive (reverse) a posted charge: a credit at the charge's own rate allocated to the charge, with the
 * GL reversed. Call inside a transaction. */
function CreditControlWaiveCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM creditcharges WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "' AND waived=0");
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Charge) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'] . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($WaiverID, $WaiverNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($Charge['debtorno'], 71, -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, $Text, $PeriodNo);
	CreditControlAllocate($WaiverID, $Charge['transid'], $Charge['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate'], 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges SET waived=1, waivetransno='" . $WaiverNo . "', waivereason='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reason, 0, 200)) . "' WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'");
	CreditControlLog($Charge['debtorno'], 'waiver', $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'], '', $Charge['amount'], $Charge['currcode'], $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved write-off: a credit (type 72) allocated oldest first to the customer's open
 * debit items; GL credit to debtors at the items' original rates, debit to bad debts at today's rate,
 * the difference to the exchange difference account. Call inside a transaction.
 * Returns the write-off transaction number or 0 if the balance no longer covers the amount. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Amount, $Reason) {
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND balance > 0.005
						ORDER BY trandate, id FOR UPDATE");
	$Items = array();
	$Open = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Open += $MyRow['balance'];
	}
	if ($Amount <= 0 or $Amount > round($Open, $DecimalPlaces) + 0.005) {
		return 0;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($CreditID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 72, -$Amount, $Rate, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Text, $PeriodNo);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$HomeAtOriginalRates = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		if ($Remaining <= 0.005) {
			break;
		}
		$Part = round(min($Remaining, $Item['balance']), $DecimalPlaces);
		CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $Item['id'], $Part);
		$ItemRate = ($Item['rate'] > 0) ? $Item['rate'] : $Rate;
		$HomeAtOriginalRates += round($Part / $ItemRate, 2);
		$Remaining -= $Part;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeNow = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text;
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$HomeAtOriginalRates);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CreditControlBadDebtAct'], $Narrative, $HomeNow);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' (' . __('exchange difference') . ')', $HomeAtOriginalRates - $HomeNow);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Substitute the placeholders of a reminder letter */
function CreditControlLetterText($Template, $Name, $CurrCode, $Total, $InvoiceLines) {
	return str_replace(array('{name}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}', '{date}'),
		array($Name, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'], $CurrCode, locale_number_format($Total, 2), $InvoiceLines, date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'])),
		$Template);
}

	return $Status;
}

function CreditControlStatusName($Disallow) {
	if ($Disallow == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Disallow == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* True if no order may be accepted or released for the customer (credit status disallows invoicing) */
function CreditControlOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status['disallow'] == 1);
}

/* Write one line of the per customer credit control history (reviews, status and limit changes,
 * reminders, charges, waivers, write-offs). Never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $OldValue, $NewValue, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Reason) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno, eventdate, userid, eventtype, oldvalue, newvalue, amount, currcode, reason)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')",
			__('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* Put a customer on 'stop', 'watch' or back to 'normal' and log it. $NewStatus: 'stop', 'watch', 'normal'.
 * Returns true if the status changed. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $Reason) {
	$Old = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($NewStatus == 'stop') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Stop');
	} elseif ($NewStatus == 'watch') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Watch');
	} else {
		$Code = 0;
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode=0");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			return false; // no 'normal' credit status record, cannot clear
		}
	}
	if ($Code == $Old['code']) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $Code . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'status', $Old['name'], $New['name'], 0, '', $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Credit limit of a customer changed by credit control. */
function CreditControlSetLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditlimit'] != $NewLimit) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float)$NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
				__('The credit limit could not be updated because'));
		CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'limit', $MyRow['creditlimit'], $NewLimit, $NewLimit, $MyRow['currcode'], $Reason);
	}
}

/* Next review date for a customer account opened today */
function CreditControlDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths'] : 12;
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row (needs paymentterms joined as paymentterms) */
function CreditControlDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Open items of a customer that are past due, oldest first. Disputed items are left out.
 * $Types is a list of debtortrans types to include. Returns an array of rows with
 * id, type, transno, trandate, duedate, balance, daysoverdue. */
function CreditControlOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $Types = array(10, 70), $MinDaysOverdue = 1) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					" . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . implode(',', array_map('intval', $Types)) . ")
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.disputed=0
				AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Total account balance of a customer in its own currency (all open items, unallocated credits net) */
function CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float)$MyRow[0];
}

/* Amount of the overdue items that is really still owed: unallocated receipts and credit notes
 * on the account reduce what we chase or charge interest on. */
function CreditControlNetOverdue($Items, $DebtorNo) {
	$Total = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Total += $Item['balance'];
	}
	return max(0, min($Total, CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo)));
}

/* Last reminder stage sent in the current overdue episode (letters sent since the oldest
 * overdue item fell due), 0 if none. $OldestDueDate is Y-m-d */
function CreditControlLastStage($DebtorNo, $OldestDueDate = '1000-01-01') {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(stage) AS stage, MAX(sentdate) AS sentdate
						FROM dunninglog
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND sentdate >= '" . $OldestDueDate . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array((int)$MyRow['stage'], $MyRow['sentdate']);
}

/* Rate (customer currency per home currency unit) and decimal places for a currency */
function CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$MyRow or $MyRow['rate'] <= 0) {
		return array(1, 2);
	}
	return array($MyRow['rate'], $MyRow['decimalplaces']);
}

/* Insert a debtortrans row for a credit control posting. $Amount is signed, in customer currency.
 * Must be called inside the caller's transaction. Returns array(transid, transno). */
function CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $Reference, $Text, $PeriodNo) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
							(SELECT custbranch.branchcode FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS branchcode,
							(SELECT custbranch.salesman FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS salesman
						FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno, type, debtorno, branchcode, trandate, inputdate, prd, reference, tpe, order_, rate, ovamount, invtext, salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['branchcode']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						NOW(),
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salestype']) . "',
						0,
						'" . (float)$Rate . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salesman']) . "')",
			__('The debtors ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
	return array(DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id'), $TransNo);
}

function CreditControlInsertGL($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Account) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "')",
			__('The general ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
}

/* Allocate (part of) a credit item to an open debit item and settle them if they reach zero */
function CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $DebitID, $Amount) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . (float)$Amount . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$CreditID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$DebitID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')");
}

/* Post interest or a late fee (one charge row per customer, month and type) in the customer's
 * currency. Call inside a transaction. Returns false when the charge was already posted. */
function CreditControlPostCharge($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Month, $ChargeType, $Amount, $Basis) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id FROM creditcharges
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND chargemonth='" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "'
							AND chargetype='" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		return false;
	}
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	if ($Amount <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Description = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? __('Interest on overdue balance') : __('Late payment fee');
	list($TransID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 70, $Amount, $Rate, $Description . ' ' . $Month, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' - ' . $Basis, $PeriodNo);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype, amount, currcode, rate, transid, transno, basis, postedby, posteddate)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "',
						'" . $Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . $Rate . "',
						'" . $TransID . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Basis, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE)",
			__('The charge record could not be inserted because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'charge', '', $ChargeType . ' ' . $Month, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' (' . $Basis . ')');
	return true;
}

/* Waive (reverse) a posted charge: a credit at the charge's own rate allocated to the charge, with the
 * GL reversed. Call inside a transaction. */
function CreditControlWaiveCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM creditcharges WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "' AND waived=0");
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Charge) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'] . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($WaiverID, $WaiverNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($Charge['debtorno'], 71, -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, $Text, $PeriodNo);
	CreditControlAllocate($WaiverID, $Charge['transid'], $Charge['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate'], 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges SET waived=1, waivetransno='" . $WaiverNo . "', waivereason='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reason, 0, 200)) . "' WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'");
	CreditControlLog($Charge['debtorno'], 'waiver', $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'], '', $Charge['amount'], $Charge['currcode'], $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved write-off: a credit (type 72) allocated oldest first to the customer's open
 * debit items; GL credit to debtors at the items' original rates, debit to bad debts at today's rate,
 * the difference to the exchange difference account. Call inside a transaction.
 * Returns the write-off transaction number or 0 if the balance no longer covers the amount. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Amount, $Reason) {
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND balance > 0.005
						ORDER BY trandate, id FOR UPDATE");
	$Items = array();
	$Open = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Open += $MyRow['balance'];
	}
	if ($Amount <= 0 or $Amount > round($Open, $DecimalPlaces) + 0.005) {
		return 0;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($CreditID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 72, -$Amount, $Rate, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Text, $PeriodNo);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$HomeAtOriginalRates = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		if ($Remaining <= 0.005) {
			break;
		}
		$Part = round(min($Remaining, $Item['balance']), $DecimalPlaces);
		CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $Item['id'], $Part);
		$ItemRate = ($Item['rate'] > 0) ? $Item['rate'] : $Rate;
		$HomeAtOriginalRates += round($Part / $ItemRate, 2);
		$Remaining -= $Part;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeNow = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text;
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$HomeAtOriginalRates);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CreditControlBadDebtAct'], $Narrative, $HomeNow);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' (' . __('exchange difference') . ')', $HomeAtOriginalRates - $HomeNow);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Substitute the placeholders of a reminder letter */
function CreditControlLetterText($Template, $Name, $CurrCode, $Total, $InvoiceLines) {
	return str_replace(array('{name}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}', '{date}'),
		array($Name, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'], $CurrCode, locale_number_format($Total, 2), $InvoiceLines, date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'])),
		$Template);
}
