<?php

/* Shared functions for credit control: status, audit log, overdue calculation and the
 * debtors ledger postings for interest/fees, waivers and write-offs.
 *
 * Stop and watch are the existing credit status (holdreasons) records: a stop is a hold reason
 * with dissallowinvoices=1 and a watch one with dissallowinvoices=2, so every page that already
 * honours debtorsmaster.holdreason keeps working.
 */

// Pages include SQL_CommonFunctions.php with a plain include, so only load it when it is not there yet
if (!function_exists('GetNextTransNo')) {
	include(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
}

define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 17); // credit controller, deputy and finance director
define('CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN', 21); // finance director: write-off approval and setup

function CanDoCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CanApproveCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* A sales rep (SalesmanLogin set) may only see his own customers. Customer log ons are
 * restricted to their own account. Returns false if the user may not see $DebtorNo */
function CreditControlCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (!empty($_SESSION['CustomerLogin']) and $_SESSION['CustomerLogin'] == 1) {
		return ($_SESSION['CustomerID'] == $DebtorNo);
	}
	if ($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesman='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		return (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* The hold reason code used for a credit control stop or watch, creating the record if the
 * database does not have it yet (for example a demo install). $Which is 'Stop' or 'Watch' */
function CreditControlReasonCode($Which) {
	$Name = 'CreditControl' . $Which . 'Reason';
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Name]) and $_SESSION[$Name] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$_SESSION[$Name] . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
			return (int)$_SESSION[$Name];
		}
	}
	$Description = ($Which == 'Stop') ? 'Credit control - on stop' : 'Credit control - on watch';
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasondescription='" . $Description . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(reasoncode) FROM holdreasons");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = max(89, (int)$MyRow[0]) + 1;
		DB_query("INSERT INTO holdreasons (reasoncode, reasondescription, dissallowinvoices)
					VALUES ('" . $Code . "', '" . $Description . "', '" . (($Which == 'Stop') ? 1 : 2) . "')");
	} else {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = $MyRow[0];
	}
	DB_query("DELETE FROM config WHERE confname='" . $Name . "'");
	DB_query("INSERT INTO config (confname, confvalue) VALUES ('" . $Name . "', '" . $Code . "')");
	$_SESSION[$Name] = $Code;
	return (int)$Code;
}

/* Current credit status of a customer: array('code', 'disallow' 0|1|2, 'description', 'name') */
function CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
							holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
							holdreasons.reasondescription
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Status = array('code' => 0, 'disallow' => 0, 'description' => '', 'name' => __('Normal'));
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['disallow'] = (int)$MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['name'] = CreditControlStatusName($Status['disallow']);
	}
	return $Status;
}

function CreditControlStatusName($Disallow) {
	if ($Disallow == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Disallow == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* True if no order may be accepted or released for the customer (credit status disallows invoicing) */
function CreditControlOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status['disallow'] == 1);
}

/* Why an existing order may not be dispatched or invoiced, or '' if it may: held for going over the
 * credit limit, or the customer is on stop. Credit control releases an order (creditheld=2) to
 * allow it despite either. */
function CreditControlOrderBlocked($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salesorders.creditheld, holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON salesorders.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE salesorders.orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if ($MyRow['creditheld'] == 1) {
			return __('This order is held for credit control approval because it takes the customer over their credit limit');
		}
		if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1 and $MyRow['creditheld'] != 2) {
			return __('This customer account is on stop. The order cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* Write one line of the per customer credit control history (reviews, status and limit changes,
 * reminders, charges, waivers, write-offs). Never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $OldValue, $NewValue, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Reason) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno, eventdate, userid, eventtype, oldvalue, newvalue, amount, currcode, reason)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')",
			__('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* Put a customer on 'stop', 'watch' or back to 'normal' and log it. $NewStatus: 'stop', 'watch', 'normal'.
 * Returns true if the status changed. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $Reason) {
	$Old = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($NewStatus == 'stop') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Stop');
	} elseif ($NewStatus == 'watch') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Watch');
	} else {
		$Code = 0;
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode=0");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			return false; // no 'normal' credit status record, cannot clear
		}
	}
	if ($Code == $Old['code']) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $Code . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'status', $Old['name'], $New['name'], 0, '', $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Credit limit of a customer changed by credit control. */
function CreditControlSetLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditlimit'] != $NewLimit) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float)$NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
				__('The credit limit could not be updated because'));
		CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'limit', $MyRow['creditlimit'], $NewLimit, $NewLimit, $MyRow['currcode'], $Reason);
	}
}

/* Next review date for a customer account opened today */
function CreditControlDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths'] : 12;
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row (needs paymentterms joined as paymentterms) */
function CreditControlDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Open items of a customer that are past due, oldest first. Disputed items are left out.
 * $Types is a list of debtortrans types to include. Returns an array of rows with
 * id, type, transno, trandate, duedate, balance, daysoverdue. */
function CreditControlOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $Types = array(10, 70), $MinDaysOverdue = 1) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					" . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . implode(',', array_map('intval', $Types)) . ")
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.disputed=0
				AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Total account balance of a customer in its own currency (all open items, unallocated credits net) */
function CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float)$MyRow[0];
}

/* Amount of the overdue items that is really still owed: unallocated receipts and credit notes
 * on the account reduce what we chase or charge interest on. */
function CreditControlNetOverdue($Items, $DebtorNo) {
	$Total = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Total += $Item['balance'];
	}
	return max(0, min($Total, CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo)));
}

/* Last reminder stage sent in the current overdue episode (letters sent since the oldest
 * overdue item fell due), 0 if none. $OldestDueDate is Y-m-d */
function CreditControlLastStage($DebtorNo, $OldestDueDate = '1000-01-01') {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(stage) AS stage, MAX(sentdate) AS sentdate
						FROM dunninglog
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND sentdate >= '" . $OldestDueDate . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array((int)$MyRow['stage'], $MyRow['sentdate']);
}

/* Rate (customer currency per home currency unit) and decimal places for a currency */
function CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$MyRow or $MyRow['rate'] <= 0) {
		return array(1, 2);
	}
	return array($MyRow['rate'], $MyRow['decimalplaces']);
}

/* Insert a debtortrans row for a credit control posting. $Amount is signed, in customer currency.
 * Must be called inside the caller's transaction. Returns array(transid, transno). */
function CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $Reference, $Text, $PeriodNo) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
							(SELECT custbranch.branchcode FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS branchcode,
							(SELECT custbranch.salesman FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS salesman
						FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno, type, debtorno, branchcode, trandate, inputdate, prd, reference, tpe, order_, rate, ovamount, invtext, salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['branchcode']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						NOW(),
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salestype']) . "',
						0,
						'" . (float)$Rate . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salesman']) . "')",
			__('The debtors ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
	return array(DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id'), $TransNo);
}

function CreditControlInsertGL($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Account) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "')",
			__('The general ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
}

/* Allocate (part of) a credit item to an open debit item and settle them if they reach zero */
function CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $DebitID, $Amount) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . (float)$Amount . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$CreditID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$DebitID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')");
}

/* Post interest or a late fee (one charge row per customer, month and type) in the customer's
 * currency. Call inside a transaction. Returns false when the charge was already posted. */
function CreditControlPostCharge($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Month, $ChargeType, $Amount, $Basis) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id FROM creditcharges
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND chargemonth='" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "'
							AND chargetype='" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		return false;
	}
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	if ($Amount <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Description = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? __('Interest on overdue balance') : __('Late payment fee');
	list($TransID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 70, $Amount, $Rate, $Description . ' ' . $Month, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' - ' . $Basis, $PeriodNo);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype, amount, currcode, rate, transid, transno, basis, postedby, posteddate)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "',

						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',

			__('The charge record could not be inserted because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'charge', '', $ChargeType . ' ' . $Month, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' (' . $Basis . ')');
	return true;
}

/* Waive (reverse) a posted charge: a credit at the charge's own rate allocated to the charge, with the
 * GL reversed. Call inside a transaction. */
function CreditControlWaiveCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM creditcharges WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "' AND waived=0");
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Charge) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'] . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($WaiverID, $WaiverNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($Charge['debtorno'], 71, -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, $Text, $PeriodNo);
	CreditControlAllocate($WaiverID, $Charge['transid'], $Charge['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate'], 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges SET waived=1, waivetransno='" . $WaiverNo . "', waivereason='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reason, 0, 200)) . "' WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'");
	CreditControlLog($Charge['debtorno'], 'waiver', $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'], '', $Charge['amount'], $Charge['currcode'], $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved write-off: a credit (type 72) allocated oldest first to the customer's open
 * debit items; GL credit to debtors at the items' original rates, debit to bad debts at today's rate,
 * the difference to the exchange difference account. Call inside a transaction.
 * Returns the write-off transaction number or 0 if the balance no longer covers the amount. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Amount, $Reason) {
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND balance > 0.005
						ORDER BY trandate, id FOR UPDATE");
	$Items = array();
	$Open = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Open += $MyRow['balance'];
	}
	if ($Amount <= 0 or $Amount > round($Open, $DecimalPlaces) + 0.005) {
		return 0;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($CreditID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 72, -$Amount, $Rate, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Text, $PeriodNo);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$HomeAtOriginalRates = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		if ($Remaining <= 0.005) {
			break;
		}
		$Part = round(min($Remaining, $Item['balance']), $DecimalPlaces);
		CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $Item['id'], $Part);
		$ItemRate = ($Item['rate'] > 0) ? $Item['rate'] : $Rate;
		$HomeAtOriginalRates += round($Part / $ItemRate, 2);
		$Remaining -= $Part;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeNow = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text;
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$HomeAtOriginalRates);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CreditControlBadDebtAct'], $Narrative, $HomeNow);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' (' . __('exchange difference') . ')', $HomeAtOriginalRates - $HomeNow);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Substitute the placeholders of a reminder letter */
function CreditControlLetterText($Template, $Name, $CurrCode, $Total, $InvoiceLines) {
	return str_replace(array('{name}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}', '{date}'),
		array($Name, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'], $CurrCode, locale_number_format($Total, 2), $InvoiceLines, date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'])),
		$Template);
}

/** This function takes a debtorno and returns an associative array containing
   the database record for that debtor. If the debtor number doesn't exist
   then it returns an $Errors array.
*/
function GetCustomer($DebtorNumber, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors = VerifyDebtorExists($DebtorNumber, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL="SELECT * FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='".$DebtorNumber."'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Errors[0] = 0; // None found.
	$Errors[1] = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	return $Errors;
}

/** This function takes a field name, and a string, and then returns an
   array of debtornos that fulfill this criteria.
*/
function SearchCustomers($Field, $Criteria, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL='SELECT debtorno
		FROM debtorsmaster
		WHERE '.$Field." LIKE '%".$Criteria."%'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$DebtorList = array(0);	    // First element: no errors
	while ($MyRow=DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$DebtorList[]=$MyRow[0];
	}
	return $DebtorList;
}

<?php

/* Shared functions for credit control: status, audit log, overdue calculation and the
 * debtors ledger postings for interest/fees, waivers and write-offs.
 *
 * Stop and watch are the existing credit status (holdreasons) records: a stop is a hold reason
 * with dissallowinvoices=1 and a watch one with dissallowinvoices=2, so every page that already
 * honours debtorsmaster.holdreason keeps working.
 */

// Pages include SQL_CommonFunctions.php with a plain include, so only load it when it is not there yet
if (!function_exists('GetNextTransNo')) {
	include(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
}

define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 17); // credit controller, deputy and finance director
define('CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN', 21); // finance director: write-off approval and setup

function CanDoCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CanApproveCreditControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* A sales rep (SalesmanLogin set) may only see his own customers. Customer log ons are
 * restricted to their own account. Returns false if the user may not see $DebtorNo */
function CreditControlCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (!empty($_SESSION['CustomerLogin']) and $_SESSION['CustomerLogin'] == 1) {
		return ($_SESSION['CustomerID'] == $DebtorNo);
	}
	if ($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesman='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		return (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* The hold reason code used for a credit control stop or watch, creating the record if the
 * database does not have it yet (for example a demo install). $Which is 'Stop' or 'Watch' */
function CreditControlReasonCode($Which) {
	$Name = 'CreditControl' . $Which . 'Reason';
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Name]) and $_SESSION[$Name] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$_SESSION[$Name] . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
			return (int)$_SESSION[$Name];
		}
	}
	$Description = ($Which == 'Stop') ? 'Credit control - on stop' : 'Credit control - on watch';
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasondescription='" . $Description . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(reasoncode) FROM holdreasons");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = max(89, (int)$MyRow[0]) + 1;
		DB_query("INSERT INTO holdreasons (reasoncode, reasondescription, dissallowinvoices)
					VALUES ('" . $Code . "', '" . $Description . "', '" . (($Which == 'Stop') ? 1 : 2) . "')");
	} else {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Code = $MyRow[0];
	}
	DB_query("DELETE FROM config WHERE confname='" . $Name . "'");
	DB_query("INSERT INTO config (confname, confvalue) VALUES ('" . $Name . "', '" . $Code . "')");
	$_SESSION[$Name] = $Code;
	return (int)$Code;
}

/* Current credit status of a customer: array('code', 'disallow' 0|1|2, 'description', 'name') */
function CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
							holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
							holdreasons.reasondescription
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Status = array('code' => 0, 'disallow' => 0, 'description' => '', 'name' => __('Normal'));
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['disallow'] = (int)$MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['name'] = CreditControlStatusName($Status['disallow']);
	}
	return $Status;
}

/* dissallowinvoices value (0, 1 or 2) of a hold reason code */
function CreditControlStatusOf($ReasonCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		return (int)$MyRow[0];
	}
	return 0;
}

function CreditControlStatusName($Disallow) {
	if ($Disallow == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Disallow == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* True if no order may be accepted or released for the customer (credit status disallows invoicing) */
function CreditControlOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status['disallow'] == 1);
}

/* Why an existing order may not be dispatched or invoiced, or '' if it may: held for going over the
 * credit limit, or the customer is on stop. Credit control releases an order (creditheld=2) to
 * allow it despite either. */
function CreditControlOrderBlocked($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salesorders.creditheld, holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON salesorders.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE salesorders.orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if ($MyRow['creditheld'] == 1) {
			return __('This order is held for credit control approval because it takes the customer over their credit limit');
		}
		if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1 and $MyRow['creditheld'] != 2) {
			return __('This customer account is on stop. The order cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* Write one line of the per customer credit control history (reviews, status and limit changes,
 * reminders, charges, waivers, write-offs). Never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $OldValue, $NewValue, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Reason) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno, eventdate, userid, eventtype, oldvalue, newvalue, amount, currcode, reason)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')",
			__('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* Put a customer on 'stop', 'watch' or back to 'normal' and log it. $NewStatus: 'stop', 'watch', 'normal'.
 * Returns true if the status changed. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $Reason) {
	$Old = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($NewStatus == 'stop') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Stop');
	} elseif ($NewStatus == 'watch') {
		$Code = CreditControlReasonCode('Watch');
	} else {
		$Code = 0;
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode=0");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			return false; // no 'normal' credit status record, cannot clear
		}
	}
	if ($Code == $Old['code']) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $Code . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = CreditControlStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'status', $Old['name'], $New['name'], 0, '', $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Credit limit of a customer changed by credit control. */
function CreditControlSetLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditlimit'] != $NewLimit) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float)$NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
				__('The credit limit could not be updated because'));
		CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'limit', $MyRow['creditlimit'], $NewLimit, $NewLimit, $MyRow['currcode'], $Reason);
	}
}

/* Next review date for a customer account opened today */
function CreditControlDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditControlReviewMonths'] : 12;
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row (needs paymentterms joined as paymentterms) */
function CreditControlDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Open items of a customer that are past due, oldest first. Disputed items are left out.
 * $Types is a list of debtortrans types to include. Returns an array of rows with
 * id, type, transno, trandate, duedate, balance, daysoverdue. */
function CreditControlOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $Types = array(10, 70), $MinDaysOverdue = 1) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					" . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . implode(',', array_map('intval', $Types)) . ")
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.disputed=0
				AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . CreditControlDueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Total account balance of a customer in its own currency (all open items, unallocated credits net) */
function CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float)$MyRow[0];
}

/* Amount of the overdue items that is really still owed: unallocated receipts and credit notes
 * on the account reduce what we chase or charge interest on. */
function CreditControlNetOverdue($Items, $DebtorNo) {
	$Total = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Total += $Item['balance'];
	}
	return max(0, min($Total, CreditControlAccountBalance($DebtorNo)));
}

/* Last reminder stage sent in the current overdue episode (letters sent since the oldest
 * overdue item fell due), 0 if none. $OldestDueDate is Y-m-d */
function CreditControlLastStage($DebtorNo, $OldestDueDate = '1000-01-01') {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(stage) AS stage, MAX(sentdate) AS sentdate
						FROM dunninglog
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND sentdate >= '" . $OldestDueDate . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array((int)$MyRow['stage'], $MyRow['sentdate']);
}

/* Rate (customer currency per home currency unit) and decimal places for a currency */
function CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$MyRow or $MyRow['rate'] <= 0) {
		return array(1, 2);
	}
	return array($MyRow['rate'], $MyRow['decimalplaces']);
}

/* Insert a debtortrans row for a credit control posting. $Amount is signed, in customer currency.
 * Must be called inside the caller's transaction. Returns array(transid, transno). */
function CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $Reference, $Text, $PeriodNo) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
							(SELECT custbranch.branchcode FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS branchcode,
							(SELECT custbranch.salesman FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode LIMIT 1) AS salesman
						FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno, type, debtorno, branchcode, trandate, inputdate, prd, reference, tpe, order_, rate, ovamount, invtext, salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['branchcode']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						NOW(),
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salestype']) . "',
						0,
						'" . (float)$Rate . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Customer['salesman']) . "')",
			__('The debtors ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
	return array(DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id'), $TransNo);
}

function CreditControlInsertGL($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						CURRENT_DATE,
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Account) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . (float)$Amount . "')",
			__('The general ledger entry could not be inserted because'));
}

/* Allocate (part of) a credit item to an open debit item and settle them if they reach zero */
function CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $DebitID, $Amount) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . (float)$Amount . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$CreditID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . (float)$Amount . " WHERE id='" . (int)$DebitID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$CreditID . "', '" . (int)$DebitID . "')");
}

/* Post interest or a late fee (one charge row per customer, month and type) in the customer's
 * currency. Call inside a transaction. Returns false when the charge was already posted. */
function CreditControlPostCharge($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Month, $ChargeType, $Amount, $Basis) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id FROM creditcharges
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND chargemonth='" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "'
							AND chargetype='" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		return false;
	}
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	if ($Amount <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Description = ($ChargeType == 'interest') ? __('Interest on overdue balance') : __('Late payment fee');
	list($TransID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 70, $Amount, $Rate, $Description . ' ' . $Month, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' - ' . $Basis, $PeriodNo);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(70, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Description . ' ' . $Month, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype, amount, currcode, rate, transid, transno, basis, postedby, posteddate)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Month) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($ChargeType) . "',
						'" . $Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
						'" . $Rate . "',
						'" . $TransID . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Basis, 0, 200)) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						CURRENT_DATE)",
			__('The charge record could not be inserted because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, 'charge', '', $ChargeType . ' ' . $Month, $Amount, $CurrCode, $Description . ' ' . $Month . ' (' . $Basis . ')');
	return true;
}

/* Waive (reverse) a posted charge: a credit at the charge's own rate allocated to the charge, with the
 * GL reversed. Call inside a transaction. */
function CreditControlWaiveCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM creditcharges WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "' AND waived=0");
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Charge) {
		return false;
	}
	$IncomeAccount = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'interest') ? $_SESSION['CreditControlInterestAct'] : $_SESSION['CreditControlFeeAct'];
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'] . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($WaiverID, $WaiverNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($Charge['debtorno'], 71, -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, $Text, $PeriodNo);
	CreditControlAllocate($WaiverID, $Charge['transid'], $Charge['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate'], 2);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $IncomeAccount, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $HomeAmount);
		CreditControlInsertGL(71, $WaiverNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$HomeAmount);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges SET waived=1, waivetransno='" . $WaiverNo . "', waivereason='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reason, 0, 200)) . "' WHERE id='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'");
	CreditControlLog($Charge['debtorno'], 'waiver', $Charge['chargetype'] . ' ' . $Charge['chargemonth'], '', $Charge['amount'], $Charge['currcode'], $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved write-off: a credit (type 72) allocated oldest first to the customer's open
 * debit items; GL credit to debtors at the items' original rates, debit to bad debts at today's rate,
 * the difference to the exchange difference account. Call inside a transaction.
 * Returns the write-off transaction number or 0 if the balance no longer covers the amount. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $CurrCode, $Amount, $Reason) {
	list($Rate, $DecimalPlaces) = CreditControlCurrency($CurrCode);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $DecimalPlaces);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND balance > 0.005
						ORDER BY trandate, id FOR UPDATE");
	$Items = array();
	$Open = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Open += $MyRow['balance'];
	}
	if ($Amount <= 0 or $Amount > round($Open, $DecimalPlaces) + 0.005) {
		return 0;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' - ' . $Reason;
	list($CreditID, $TransNo) = CreditControlInsertDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, 72, -$Amount, $Rate, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Text, $PeriodNo);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$HomeAtOriginalRates = 0;
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		if ($Remaining <= 0.005) {
			break;
		}
		$Part = round(min($Remaining, $Item['balance']), $DecimalPlaces);
		CreditControlAllocate($CreditID, $Item['id'], $Part);
		$ItemRate = ($Item['rate'] > 0) ? $Item['rate'] : $Rate;
		$HomeAtOriginalRates += round($Part / $ItemRate, 2);
		$Remaining -= $Part;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeNow = round($Amount / $Rate, 2);
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text;
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$HomeAtOriginalRates);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CreditControlBadDebtAct'], $Narrative, $HomeNow);
		CreditControlInsertGL(72, $TransNo, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' (' . __('exchange difference') . ')', $HomeAtOriginalRates - $HomeNow);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Substitute the placeholders of a reminder letter */
function CreditControlLetterText($Template, $Name, $CurrCode, $Total, $InvoiceLines) {
	return str_replace(array('{name}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}', '{date}'),
		array($Name, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'], $CurrCode, locale_number_format($Total, 2), $InvoiceLines, date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'])),
		$Template);
}

input.content:
Credit Control

Credit control applies the same rules to every customer on account: periodic credit reviews, a stop and watch status, overdue reminder letters, month end interest and late fees, and bad debt write-offs. Everything credit control does to a customer is kept in a history that cannot be changed, which the auditors can inspect.

Credit control is done by users with the Credit control security token (the credit controller, the deputy and the Finance Director). Write-off approval and the credit control setup need the Credit control approval and setup token (the Finance Director). Sales reps and sales office staff can see the credit status but cannot change it or the credit limit.

Credit reviews

From the customer selection screen choose Credit Status and Review. The page shows the credit status, limit, balance, overdue amount and the date the next review is due. Record a review with its outcome (limit confirmed, raised, reduced, put on watch, put on stop, taken off stop or watch), the notes and the next review date. A new limit takes effect at once and is recorded with the review. Reviews are never changed or deleted. New customers get a next review date automatically, from the standard review period in the credit control setup.

Stop and watch

A customer on stop cannot have a new order accepted from any route (the sales office, counter sales, the web shop and other API clients, EDI orders and recurring orders), and goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced on orders taken before the stop. Credit control can release an individual order from the credit control report. A customer on watch can still be supplied, the person taking the order sees a warning, and orders taken for the customer are listed on the credit control report. The status is shown on the customer selection screen, on the customer inquiry pages, when taking an order and on the aged debtors report.

Stop and watch are credit status records (Setup, Credit Status). The two records used by credit control cannot be changed or deleted on the Credit Status page.

Orders over the credit limit

When credit limit checking is switched on in the system parameters (Check Credit Limits set to warn or prohibit), an order that takes the customer over the credit limit is accepted but held for credit control. It cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it from the credit control report.

Disputed invoices and exemptions

On the credit review page credit control can mark an open invoice as disputed. A disputed invoice is not chased and not charged interest until the dispute is cleared. A customer can also be exempted from interest and from late fees, with a reason.

Reminder letters

The stages (how many, the days overdue that trigger each and the wording of each letter) are set up by Finance in Credit Control Setup. Run Overdue Reminder Letters shows who will get which letter. Untick the customers to leave out of the run, for example where a payment has been promised, and press Send Reminders. Letters are emailed to the customer's accounts contact (the contact flagged for statements, otherwise the branch email). Customers without an email address are listed, and their letter is shown on screen to print and post. A customer moves up one stage at a time and only while still overdue, never receives the same stage twice and does not receive a letter within the minimum number of days after the last one. Every reminder is recorded with its date, stage, invoices and amount.

Month end interest and late fees

Month End Interest and Late Fees lists what will be charged to whom. Interest is one twelfth of the yearly rate on the undisputed invoices that are overdue by more than the charge days; the late fee is a flat fee, converted to the customer currency, once per customer per month. Interest and fees are never charged on earlier interest and fees. Press Confirm and Post Charges to raise them as separate items on the customer account (they appear on the statement as Interest and Late Fee) and in the general ledger. A month cannot be charged twice for a customer. A charge can be waived with a reason, which posts a credit to the customer and reverses the ledger entries.

Bad debt write-offs

Bad Debt Write-offs writes off all or part of the unpaid balance with a reason. Write-offs up to the limit set by Finance are posted at once; larger ones wait for the Finance Director's approval and nothing is posted until then. The write-off is allocated to the oldest open invoices, reduces the customer's balance and posts to the bad debt account; any exchange difference is posted to the exchange difference account. By default the customer is put on stop. The same page reports write-offs over a period with who requested and who approved each.

Credit control report

Credit Control Report (Receivables, Reports) lists the customers due or overdue for a review, the customers over their credit limit and by how much, the customers on watch or on stop, and the orders held for credit control or taken for customers on watch. It can be filtered by sales rep and currency and shows totals in the home currency. A sales rep sees only their own customers.

Customer portal

Customers who log in see their own balance, the reminder letters sent to them and the interest and fees charged to their account under Credit Reminders and Charges. They never see the watch status.

Month end reconciliation

Debtors Control Integrity (Utilities) compares the trade debtors control account in the general ledger with the customer accounts for the periods chosen, showing interest and fees, waivers and write-offs on their own, and lists the entries that differ and why.

Going live

On upgrade every existing customer is "normal" and gets a next review date twelve months ahead. Credit control can load the status, limit and next review date held on the old spreadsheet from Credit Control Setup (a CSV file: customer code, status, limit, next review date). Customers listed as stop are put on stop and the change is recorded in their history.

Note for sales staff

Watch: you can take orders for the customer, but you will see a warning, and credit control sees the order. Stop: the system will not accept an order for the customer and nothing is dispatched or invoiced; do not promise the customer delivery and send them to credit control. You cannot change a status or limit yourself.

Security Schema

The webERP security scheme consists of the following parts:

  1. Users:
    A separate account should be created for each user.
    User accounts may be added or removed by an administrator at:
    Main Menu > Setup > User Accounts (WWW_Users.php)
    +++
    Each user is assigned a 'Security Role' by selecting a choice
    from the drop down list labeled 'Security Role'.
    See below for a list of the default Security Roles available.
    +++
  2. Security Roles:
    Security Roles may be added or removed by an administrator at:
    Main Menu > Setup > Role Permissions (WWW_Access.php)
    +++
    Each 'Security Role' is assigned one or more 'Security Tokens'.
    The 'Security Tokens' assigned to a particular 'Security Role' can be
    changed at: Main Menu > Setup > Role Permissions (WWW_Access.php)
    +++
    See below for a list of the default 'Security Roles' and the
    'Security Tokens' assigned to each.

  3. Security Tokens:
    15 'Security Token' choices are available by default.
    See below for a list of the default 'Security Tokens'.
    Each 'Security Token' allows access to one or more webERP pages.
    +++
    There is no webERP tool to add, remove or edit 'Security Tokens'.
    However, an administrator can edit the underlying table (securitytokens).

  4. PageSecurity values:
    Each webERP page is given a Page Security value from 1 to 15 in the table scripts. The system reads all the scripts and the PageSecurity value for each into a SESSION array - $_SESSION['PageSecurityArray'] - the key for each element is the script name and the value is the PageSecurity value for that script. The key - the script name is retrieved from the $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] variable. In this way every time a script is called, the PageSecurity is retrieved from the array. +++
    There is a webERP tool to change PageSecurity values, for each script which is accessible from the Setup menu.

These parts work together as follows. The user name and password combination entered at log on enables the system to identify the 'Security Role' for the User. The User's 'Security Role' determines what 'Security Tokens' are available to the User. The User is allowed access to any page with a 'PageSecurity' value equal to the 'Security Token' values available to that User.

⬆ Top

A more comprehensive description of the security scheme follows:

Each webERP page (script) is assigned a specific PageSecurity value. This page security value is stored in the scripts table of the database and read into a SESSION array on login (from the GetConfig.php script). At the time of writing this is a number between 1 and 15. If more levels of security are necessary then this can be expanded by an administrator or developer. The default PageSecurity values for each page can be inspected by browsing the scripts table

The user is allowed access to a page if the PageSecurity value of the page/script is a number contained in the SESSION AllowedPageSecurityTokens array as determined from the users access level (Security Role). The user access level Security Role) is an integer that represents the Security Role assigned to the user in the user set up page (WWW_users.php).

Access authority is checked in the session.inc script for all pages (or PDF_Starter.inc for PDF pages). The variable $_SESSION['AccessLevel'] is retrieved from the database when the user logs on - in session.inc. This variable refers to the Security Role of the user. The SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'] array of numbers is retrieved from the database based on the users AccessLevel - or Security Role. Any page that has a $PageSecurity value equal to any value in this array is deemed to be an authorised page.

If you wish to add more Security Roles then you must use the Role Permissions script (WWW.Access.php). You must also specify the Security Tokens for the new Security Role. Users assigned to the new Security Role will have access to any page where the Page Security value is equal to a Security Token value assigned to the new Security Role. This mechanism allows the system administrator to control who can access what.

By changing the Security Role assigned to each users and the Security Tokens assigned to each Security Role the security access can be tailored for all users. When making these changes reference the default values in the tables below. PageSecurity values must also be known. The value of the default settings can be modified as needed from the Page Security script accessible from the Setup module

Changes in Later Versions

Below the default security roles and page security values are set out. However, be aware that all these settings are now modifiable in the database. The roles can be defined choosing which security tokens will be allowed. Also, as of version 4.0 it is now possible to change the PageSecurity of each script to allow access to be more tightly defined. The PageSecurity value for a particular script is mapped to the security token that is either available to a particular user or not. Without the security token being in the users list of allowed security tokens then the script will not be available to that user.

# Credit control – implementation notes

Nothing could be run here (no shell, no database), so none of this has been executed. It was written against the code and the project map; **it needs a test run on a copy of the live database before go-live** (upgrade 44, then each page).

## Design in one paragraph

webERP already has a customer "credit status" (`holdreasons`, `debtorsmaster.holdreason`) whose `dissallowinvoices` is 1 (no invoicing/orders) or 2 ("watch": the order page already warns). Stop and watch are therefore **those records**, not a new flag, so counter sales, special orders, contracts, the order pages, statements, inquiries and aged debtors keep working unchanged. Credit control adds the missing parts around it: reviews, an audit history, enforcement on the routes that never checked status, reminders, interest/fees, waivers, write-offs, reporting, portal view, permissions, install/upgrade and docs.

## What was built

| Need | Where |
|---|---|

1. Interest: simple annual rate (Finance sets it) charged monthly as 1/12, same rate for all currencies and countries.
2. Late fee: one flat fee per customer per month, set in the home currency and converted at the current rate to the customer's currency.
3. No interest on interest or fees (type 70 items are never in the base). Interest only on undisputed invoices overdue more than the "charge days"; payments on account reduce the base.

7. Reps see the stop/watch status and the reason text (the status description).
8. Letters are in the wording Finance enters; no per-language letters (open question 9).
9. Watch status is not shown in the portal (the portal page shows balance, reminders, charges only).
10. Credit limit is per customer account (`debtorsmaster`); there is no head-office/branch group limit in webERP.
11. Cover when both are away: access is the security token, so Finance gives the token to whoever covers.

- **Ledger postings**: new transaction types 70 (interest/fee), 71 (waiver), 72 (write-off) in `systypes`, so they appear on statements and in the aged debtors report under their own names. Write-offs credit debtors control at the invoices' original rates, debit bad debts at today's rate and post the difference to the sales exchange difference account (BR-27). Write-offs are allocated oldest first to open items.
- **Uniqueness**: `creditcharges` has a unique key (customer, month, type), so a month can never be charged twice even with two users. The "month" is a label chosen on the page (default current month); balances are as of today.
- **Reminders**: one stage at a time, never the same stage twice in the current overdue episode, and not within `CreditControlDunningGap` days of the last letter. - **Immutability**: `creditreviews`, `creditcontrollog` and `dunninglog` have no update or delete code anywhere.
- **Go-live**: update 44 sets `nextreviewdate` to +12 months for all customers; the spreadsheet stop list and limits load through the CSV on `CreditControlSetup.php`, with each change logged. Status stays "normal" until loaded.
- **Security tokens 17 and 21** are new. - `CheckCreditLimits` must be set to warn or prohibit in system parameters for over-limit holds (BR-10); it is not changed by the upgrade because turning it on at go-live would hold orders for every customer still on the default 1000 limit.

- Not covered by any automated test; the repo has no harness for these pages.
